column1: # One row per UNGUARDED bare-`localStorage` access (a site NOT lexically inside a
# try block). The gate FAILS `--check` on any flagged site NOT listed here (NEW),
# so a newly-added unguarded access must be judged before it can merge. Judge:
# is it reached during SYNCHRONOUS page boot (a top-level statement, an init IIFE,
# or a function called at load)? If yes it can white-screen a storage-blocked
# browser (iOS "Block All Cookies", sandboxed webview) — GUARD it (try/catch or a
# safeLsGet wrapper), don't add a SAFE row. If it only runs later from a user
# handler / an async chain whose caller .catch()es / a node-only script, it can't
# brick boot — mark SAFE with the reason.
# FILE <TAB> SNIPPET-KEY <TAB> STATUS <TAB> REASON   (# = comment / blank skipped)
